module: Skeleton class representing a vehicle snapshot (position, orientation, steering, timestamp) attached to a rally transcriptions path. It behaves like an element of `sortedList` (fields id, name, sortOrder). The module returns a constructor: `require(...)(path, name, forceId)`. In this version, most fields stay nil and deserialization is empty.
notes: onSerialize reads self.text, which is never initialized in init: the serialized `text` field will always be nil.
onDeserialized does nothing (the whole body is commented out): the code appears to be an unfinished copy of transcripts/entry.lua.

C.desc: Vehicle snapshot. Initialized fields: path, id, name, sortOrder, pos, quat, steering, timestamp, cornerCall (the last five nil).

init.desc: Constructor called by the function returned by the module. Stores the parent path, takes the provided id or a new id via path:getNextUniqueIdentifier(), and names the object `t_<id>` by default.

forceId.desc: Forced id (for example during a load).

onSerialize.desc: Returns a table {oldId, name, text} for saving.

returns.desc: Serializable data (text is nil, see notes).

onDeserialized.desc: Restoration from the saved data. Does nothing in this version.

oldIdMap.desc: Mapping table of the old ids.
